name: reconcile
description: Exact/normalize/date_window match two Excel Tables by key columns; write a new result sheet only

tools.name: reconcile_tables
tools.description: Compare two Excel Tables by one or more key columns. Writes a NEW sheet (never overwrites sources) with status matched|left_only|right_only|conflict. Default exact match after trim; optional matchMode normalize (keyNormalize trim_lower/trim_collapse_ws) or date_window (±N days second pass, needs leftDateKey/rightDateKey in keys). Blank keys never match; no fuzzy match. Duplicate keys pair equal remaining rows first (order-independent), leftover same-key rows with different values are conflict. Both sides must already be Tables (use ensure_table first).

keys.description: Join key header name(s), comma-separated. Example: 订单号。date_window 时须含日期列对（leftDateKey + rightDateKey）

compareColumns.description: Columns to check for conflicts when keys match. Default: all shared non-key columns

outputSheet.description: New sheet name. Default 对账结果

matchMode.description: 匹配模式：exact（默认，trim 后精确相等）| normalize（键标准化后再精确匹配）| date_window（键匹配后按日期窗口二次配对）

keyNormalize.description: 键标准化（normalize / date_window 时生效）：trim 去首尾空格（默认）| trim_lower 去空格+小写 | trim_collapse_ws 去空格+合并连续空白

dateWindowDays.description: 仅 matchMode=date_window：允许的日期差窗口 ±N 天

leftDateKey.description: 左表日期列名（须在 keys 中），仅 date_window 使用

rightDateKey.description: 右表日期列名（须在 keys 中），仅 date_window 使用

auditColumns.description: 输出行级审计列 __match_mode / __match_score / __review；非 exact 默认 true
